in_sanskrit.name: Bapun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Father, Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bapun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit 'Babhu' and 'Putra' meaning 'Father' and 'Son' respectively. The name 'Bapun' signifies a protector or a father figure. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as the protector of the universe.
